items.title: FFO: Chillin – “Perpetual Motion”
items.summary: The Concord, New Hampshire band FFO: Chillin has a warm, comforting, instantly familiar sound that's weirdly hard to describe. They basically make big, hearty '90s-style indie-punk anthems with occasional hardcore breakdowns, and their songs tend to be really short. Last month, they released " All I Know ," their first single for the great hardcore-centric label DAZE, and I saw them open for Joyce Manor and Glitterer in Charlottesville. They were drunk and sloppy and really, really fun. Today, they've got another song. The post FFO: Chillin – “Perpetual Motion” appeared first on Stereogum .

items.title: Daughter’s Elena Tonra Announces New Ex:Re Album Save As: Hear “Radio Station”
items.summary: Ever since 2010, Elena Tonra has led the London indie-rolk trio Daughter; they shared their decade-old outtake " Not Enough " earlier this year. Back in 2018, Tonra released a self-titled solo album under the name Ex:Re. She never intended to make a follow-up, but she got to working on a few fragments of songs a few years ago, and now she's got another Ex:Re record on the way. It's called Save As — great title, a menu selection that I used constantly — and it comes out next month.
